title: Generation and application of TGFβ-educated human Vγ9Vδ2 T cells
protocol: Coat 24, 12, or 6 well plates overnight (12–16 h) at 4°C with 0.8 mg/mL pan γδ TCR antibody in PBS.
Withdraw blood from a consenting healthy volunteer and mix with sodium citrate.
Gently mix blood with an equal volume of PBS.
Gently layer the blood/PBS mix on top of 15 mL Ficoll Paque Plus in 50 mL Falcon tubes.
Centrifuge the 50 mL tubes at 750 × g for 30 min at 20°C with acceleration and brake set to 0.
Transfer the PBMC layer, seen as an interface between the plasma and the Ficoll layer, using a sterile Pasteur pipette to a fresh 50 mL Falcon tube.
Carefully remove the layer above the PBMC fraction containing plasma using a Pasteur pipette.
Add PBS to the 50 mL tube containing the PBMCs to a final volume of 50 mL and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant, leaving the pelleted cells.
If more than one tube has been used due to volume size, resuspend the pellets in TexMACSTM+ and combine them in a single tube.
Bring the cells up to a final volume of 50 mL with PBS for a second wash.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in an appropriate volume of TexMACSTM+ medium, usually 10 mL per 45 mL blood.
Count live cells using trypan blue staining and a hemocytometer.
Resuspend cells at 3 × 10^6/mL.
Aspirate the antibody-containing PBS solution from plates set up in step 1.
Wash each well once with PBS.
Plate PBMC immediately at a density of 3 × 10^6 cells/mL in 4 mL TexMACSTM+ medium per well of a 6 well plate.
Add recombinant IL-2 (100 U/mL) and recombinant TGF-β1 (5 ng/mL).
Monitor cell density by microscopy and cell counting every 2–3 days for days 1–14.
If cell density exceeds 1 × 10^6 cells/mL, add 100% TexMACSTM+ medium followed by cytokines.
Add cytokines alone if cell density is below the threshold.
Split and expand cultures into additional wells on the chosen plate type as necessary.
Expand cultures thereafter into T75 flasks.
Determine the purity of γδ T-cells by flow cytometry.
Transfer 5 × 10^4 γδ[2] and γδ[T2] cells into two separate 5 mL flow cytometry tubes.
Wash each tube with 2 mL FACS buffer (PBS with 0.5 mM EDTA and 1% FCS).
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 50 μL PBS.
Add 5 μL anti-human γδ TCR-FITC antibody to one tube containing γδ[2] and γδ[T2] cells.
Add 5 μL FITC-conjugated isotype control to the second tube containing γδ[2] and γδ[T2] cells.
Place tubes on ice for 30 min.
Wash each tube with 2 mL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100–250 μL PBS.
Analyze using flow cytometry.
Plate MDA-MB-231 tumor cells (2 × 10^4 cells each) on a 96 well electronic microtiter plate in 200 μL D10 medium.
Reconstitute DMEM medium as needed.
Pulse cells with ZOL (3 μg/mL) or medium alone after 24 hours.
Remove 100 μL of medium from each well after an additional 24 hours.
Add γδ[T2] and γδ[2] cells in 100 μL TexMACSTM+ medium to achieve a final 1:1 E:T ratio gently.
Monitor adherent tumor viability/proliferation using an xCELLigence MP impedance analyzer.
Maintain the xCELLigence MP impedance analyzer in an incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Perform dynamic monitoring of cellular impedance for label-free measurement of cellular viability.
Plate tumor cells in a 24 well microtiter plate in 1 mL D10 medium.
After 24 hours, pulse tumor cell monolayers with the indicated concentration of ZOL or pamidronic acid (PAM).
Add γδ[T2] and γδ[2] cells to achieve a final 5:1 E:T ratio.
Collect 200 μL supernatant from each well for cytokine analysis by ELISA.
Dilute supernatants 1 in 5 to measure IFN-γ and analyze undiluted for IL-2 measurement.
Prepare MTT to a concentration of 500 μg/mL in D10 medium (13 mL/24 well plate).
Remove media from each well of one 24 well plate.
Pipette 500 μL of 500 μg/mL MTT solution into each well.
Incubate at 37°C & 5% CO2 for 1 h.
Aspirate MTT solution from each well, being careful not to disturb the monolayers.
Add 500 μL DMSO into each well.
Gently swirl the plate to solubilize the formazan crystals.
Read absorbance at 560 nm using a plate reader.
Block the required number of wells in rows B and C of a 24 well plate with 1% BSA in PBS overnight at 4°C.
Place sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorfs, 20 μL and 200 μL pipette tips at 4°C overnight.
Thaw Engelbreth-Holm-Swarm (EHS) mouse sarcoma-based basement membrane extract on ice within a tissue culture hood.
Aspirate the blocking solution from the 24 well plate.
Replace the blocked wells with 650 μL TexMACSTM+ medium per well.
Mix BME with cold TexMACSTM+ media at a 1:1 ratio on ice using a cold 1.5 mL Eppendorf and pipette tips.
Keep all solutions and materials on ice during mixing to maintain low temperature.
Prepare a solution for coating Transwell inserts using BME/TexMACSTM+.
Coat ThinCertTM inserts (6.5 mm, 3 μm pore size) with 80 μL of the prepared mixture using cold pipette tips.
Ensure the solution is spread evenly on the membrane without any bubbles.
If bubbles are present, remove them gently using a tip without touching the membrane.
Place the coated Transwell inserts in rows A and D of a 24 well plate.
Incubate the 24 well plate at 37°C for at least 30 minutes or at room temperature (approximately 20°C–22°C) for more than one hour to allow BME to solidify.
Remove expanded γδ[T2] and γδ[2] cells from culture into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Count live cells using trypan blue and a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells at 350 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature (approximately 20°C–22°C).
Remove the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cells in fresh medium at a density of 1 × 10^6/mL.
If assessing antagonism of cell surface proteins, treat γδ T cells with an appropriate blocking antibody or control in PBS prior to starting the assay.
Remove the 24 well culture plate from the incubator.
Perform steps 37 or 38 less than 5 minutes before adding γδ T cells to coated ThinCertTM inserts in rows A and D.
Gently add 150 μL of re-suspended γδ[T2] and γδ[2] cells (e.g., 1.5 × 10^5 cells) to the top of the coated ThinCertTM inserts in rows A and D, thereby placing the cells on top of the BME.
Transfer the inserts into the media-containing wells in rows B and C when the assay commences.
Carefully remove the inserts from the media at predetermined time points.
Place the removed inserts in the corresponding columns in rows A and D of the 24 well plate.
Count the number of cells present in the medium using a hemocytometer.
Take three measurements for each well to account for large variations.
Add 100 IU/mL recombinant human IL-2 to activated γδ[T2] cells.
Add 200 μL RetroNectin® (1 mg/mL stock solution) to 18 mL sterile PBS in a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Aliquot 3 mL into each well of a non-tissue culture-treated 6 well plate.
Wrap the 6 well plate in Saran Wrap and store overnight at 4°C.
Rapidly thaw 1.5 mL aliquots of viral supernatant in a 37°C water bath.
Spray cryovials containing viral supernatant with 70% ethanol.
Transfer cryovials into a laminar flow hood.
Remove RetroNectin from each well of the preloaded RetroNectin-coated 6 well plate.
Add 1.5 mL of thawed viral supernatant to each well promptly.
Incubate virus-coated six-well plate for 2 hours or overnight at 4°C.
Retrieve activated γδ[T2] cells from antibody-coated plate and transfer into a Falcon tube.
Count cells using a hemocytometer and Trypan blue after gentle mixing by inversion.
Aspirate the 1.5 mL viral vector from the preloaded RetroNectin-coated 6 well plate.
Add 3 mL of freshly thawed viral supernatant to each well.
Pipette 1 × 10^6 activated γδ[T2] cells per well into the 6 well plate.
For non-transduced control γδ[T2] cells, add 3 mL D10 medium to the wells.
Add IL-2 to each well to a final concentration of 100 IU/mL.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 72 hours.
Feed γδ[T2] cells every 2 days with 100% volume increase of TexMACSTM+ medium.
Add recombinant human IL-2 to a final concentration of 100 IU/mL when feeding the cells.
Add recombinant human TGFβ1 to a final concentration of 5 ng/mL when feeding the cells.
Maintain cell density at 37°C and 5% CO2 during culture period.
If cell density is below 5 × 10^5/mL, add only 100 IU/mL recombinant human IL-2 and 5 ng/mL recombinant human TGFβ1.
On day 15 of the culture, determine transduction efficiency of γδ T-cells by flow cytometry.
Transfer 2.5 × 10^5 transduced and untransduced γδ[T2] cells into three separate 5 mL flow cytometry tubes.
Wash each tube with 2 mL PBS.
Centrifuge each tube at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard PBS and resuspend the cell pellet in 50 μL PBS.
Add 5 μL anti-human γδ TCR-FITC antibody to one tube containing untransduced γδ[T2] cells (Ut tube 1).
Add 5 μL FITC-conjugated isotype control to the second tube containing untransduced γδ[T2] cells (Ut tube 2).
Add 5 μL anti-human γδ TCR-FITC antibody to all three tubes containing transduced γδ[T2] cells (Td tubes 1–3).
Place tubes on ice for 30 min.
Wash each tube with 2 mL FACS buffer and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard PBS and resuspend cells in Ut tube 1, Ut tube 2, and Td tube 1 in 250 μL PBS.
These tubes are now ready for analysis.
Add 50 μL PBS to Ut tube 3, Td tube 2, and Td tube 3.
Add 3 μL biotinylated anti-human EGF antibody to Ut tube 3 and Td tube 3.
Place on ice for 30 min in the dark.
Wash each tube with 2 mL PBS and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard PBS and add fresh 200 μL PBS to Td tube 2.
This tube is now ready for analysis.
Discard PBS and add 50 μL to Ut tube 3 and Td tube 3.
Add 3 μL Streptavidin-PE to Ut tube 3, Td tube 2, and Td tube 3.
Incubate on ice for 30 min in the dark.
Wash each tube with 2 mL PBS and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min and return to ice.
Discard PBS and resuspend cells in 250 μL PBS.
Analyze using flow cytometry.
Seed tumor cells at 1 × 10^5 cells in 500 μL D10 medium per well in tissue culture treated 24-well plates.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Validate tumor cell surface expression of the target antigen(s) recognized by the CAR under study.
Count transduced and untransduced γδ[T2] cells on Day 2.
Resuspend cells to a density of 2 × 10^5 cells per 0.5 mL TexMACSTM+ media for a 2:1 E:T ratio.
Prepare an excess of cells for serial 2-fold dilution processing.
Add 0.5 mL CAR or non-transduced γδ[T2] cells to each well containing tumor cells in triplicate.
Add 1 mL of TexMACSTM+/D10 medium (equal parts mixture) to three wells as a control for tumor alone.
Incubate the plate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Collect supernatant on Day 3 optionally for cytokine analysis.
Analyze cytotoxicity on Day 4.
Add d-luciferin at 150 mg/mL immediately prior to luminescence reading.
Measure luminescence using appropriate apparatus and settings.
Calculate tumor cell viability using the equation provided.
Inject 1 × 10^5 ffLuc+ BxPC3 tumor cells i.p. in NSG mice.
Treat mice with 10 × 10^6 untransduced or pCAR-H/T transduced γδ[T2] cells after 12 days.
Compare treatment groups with PBS.
Prepare and activate PBMCs on day -2.
Perform steps 1–17/ 44–47 to expand sufficient numbers of pCAR-H/T transduced and untransduced γδ[T2] cells for each treatment group over a 2 week period.
Calculate the number of γδ[T2] cells required for each group using CAR T-cell expansion data from previous experiments.
Inject 1 × 105 ffLuc/RFP-expressing BxPC3 tumor cells suspended in 100 μL sterile PBS into all mice using the i.p. route on Day 1.
Take baseline weight readings and check mice for signs of ill health prior to tumor injection.
Weigh mice twice weekly.
Check for signs of ill health daily.
Humanely kill mice if weight loss exceeds 15% or total tumor flux exceeds 1 × 1010 photons per second.
Kill mice if tumor growth impairs normal behavior or vital function.

Killing is prompted by additional humane end points such as abdominal distention, dyspnoea, neurological dysfunction, lameness, jaundice, piloerection, hunched posture, inability to groom, inactivity, and/or inappetence.
On day 6, perform bioluminescence imaging of mice.
Inject mice intraperitoneally with 150 mg/kg D-luciferin.
Place mice into an anesthetic induction chamber (isoflurane 2.5%, flow rate 2 L/min) until fully anesthetized.
Image the mice with an IVIS Spectrum Imaging platform fifteen minutes after D-luciferin injection.
Determine total flux by creating a region of interest over each entire mouse.
Return mice to their cages and monitor until they have fully recovered from anesthesia.
On day 11, perform bioluminescence imaging of mice again.
Distribute mice into treatment groups if their total flux values exceed the enrollment threshold (usually >1 × 107 photons/second).
Inject the appropriate dose of transduced and untransduced γδ[T2] cells into each mouse using the i.p. route (10 × 106 cells).
Monitor the mice daily for signs of ill health.
Weigh the animals twice weekly.
Perform weekly bioluminescence imaging to monitor tumor status for the duration of the study.
Humanely sacrifice mice if total flux (p/s) values reach 1 × 1010 p/s.
Fix tumors in 10% formalin and paraffin embed them for future analysis.
Follow Perkin Elmer protocols to determine the D-luciferin kinetic curve for your model.
Determine optimal timings between injection of D-luciferin substrate and imaging prior to starting experiments.
Perform serial imaging every 5 min for a total of 40 min after injection of D-luciferin substrate.
Plot total flux against time to allow determination of an imaging time at which maximum total flux is observed.
